name: Playground Mahjong
author: Addicting Games
description: Playground Mahjong is a free Mahjong game. Welcome to the wonderful world of Mahjong is a classic strategy game that has been played for hundreds of years. Some of the strongest minds in history were players of Mahjong and it helped them sharpen their razor-sharp wits in order to take on other challenges, bigger challenges, challenges beyond the comprehension of the mortal man. Playground Mahjong is a version of Mahjong where players combine different tiles in order to create matches which thus makes the tiles disapear. In order to win you want to make all the tiles disappear as fast as you can. You can't match tiles that are locked in by other tiles so you'll have to focus your energy on the fringe tiles. You have a few special abilities that you can use in order to accomplish this goal, the game also has several different levels of difficulty. Playground Mahjong is a version of mahjong where the different tiles are all themed around the different things you can find in a playground like slides, swings, merry-go-rounds, and the jungle gym. Have fun playing mahjong.
